Polybius' initial army in Iberia before detachments and Alpine losses; not the later army at Cannae.
Roughly 40,000 infantry and 10,000 cavalry in Hannibal's multinational field army.
Polybius reports 70,000 infantry and 5,000 cavalry; the infantry total remains debated.
Polybius reports 62,000 infantry and 6,000 cavalry; elephants excluded from personnel.
Ancient order-of-battle total, rounded; a mixed phalanx, cavalry, light infantry, and auxiliaries.
